summary: Propagate trace context through an additive, optional client_v0 frame field.

replay.detail: Trace context does not replay existing claims.

schema.detail: No database schema or persisted claim format changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: older daemons ignore the field; new daemons ignore invalid values

downtime.detail: No new service interruption requirements beyond the normal binary upgrade.

manual.detail: No new required manual steps; telemetry export remains opt-in.

recovery.detail: The optional frame field adds no new rollback or roll-forward requirements.
